title: PROVISIONAL SERVICE PRODUCER PRICE INDICES (BASE YEAR 2022-23)
subtitle: FOR Q2 OF FY 2026-27, AND FINAL INDICES FOR Q1 OF FY 2026-27
body_text: The Provisional Service Producer Price Indices (SPPIs) (base year 2022-23) for Q2 of FY 2026-27 and Final SPPIs for Q1 of FY 2026-27 are as below: - S. Air (Passenger) Service Price Index 126.4 127.8 (P)-Provisional, (F)-Final Note: Weights have not been assigned to aforementioned services as these services do not cover the entire service sector. However, sub-service level weights under each service, have been computed using the data of FY 2022-23 for arriving at the PPI of respective Services. The SPPIs (Base Year 2022-23) and the Year-on-Year (YoY) inflation rate of the seven services for last four quarters are given at Annexure . Quarterly Service PPIs from Q1 of FY 2023-24 to Q2 of FY 2026-27 are available at ( https://eaindustry.nic.in/download_data_2223.asp ) Service PPIs for seven services for Q3 of FY 2026-27 will be released on Wednesday, 24 th February 2027.
